task_metadata.task_name: Modular Dialogue System with Interactable Zone, Runtime Session, MVP UI, Camera Pivot, Communication State, and Global Choice History

execution_policy.review_gate_rule: After each implemented step with repository changes, request reviewer approval and do not commit until explicit approval is received.
execution_policy.commit_rule: Single scoped commit is allowed only after reviewer approval.

steps.description: Reasoning pass: lock dialogue module boundaries, confirm integration points with current interaction flow, FSM, camera, persistence, and UI MVP before code changes.

model_config.system_instruction: Perform architecture reasoning only. Define stable dialogue contracts, lifecycle, and extension points for a Unity modular dialogue system.

nuances: One active dialogue session only.
Break path must not count as completed.
Respect current IInteractable-based interaction pipeline.

steps.description: Create dialogue module folder structure and core authoring/domain contracts: dialogue definition SO, node/option definitions, node type enum, condition contracts, and stable inspector-visible ids.

model_config.system_instruction: Implement Unity C# authoring and domain contracts for a data-oriented dialogue system.

nuances: No XML comments for public interfaces.
Ids must be stable and inspector-visible.
Support Continue, Choice, and End node types.

steps.description: Implement authoring/runtime validation path for dialogue assets: duplicate id checks, missing next node detection, invalid start node detection, empty choice node rejection, and condition target validation.

model_config.system_instruction: Add deterministic validation for dialogue data authoring to prevent broken runtime branches.

nuances: Validation errors should be actionable in inspector.
Warn on orphan nodes without blocking valid assets.

steps.description: Implement dialogue runtime session: start node resolution, current node exposure, continue flow, option selection flow, local history recording, and lifecycle statuses Idle/Running/Completed/Broken.

model_config.system_instruction: Build a deterministic dialogue session runtime with clean step iteration and lifecycle control.

nuances: Session owns progression, not UI.
Break and complete paths must be explicit and distinct.
Node resolution must support future condition growth.

steps.description: Implement condition evaluation layer with v1 conditions: AlwaysTrue, PreviousChoiceIs, and QuestCompleted. Add evaluator inputs for session local history, global history, and quest state query.

model_config.system_instruction: Create extensible dialogue branch evaluation that remains decoupled from UI and concrete quest storage.

nuances: Both nodes and options can be gated.
Hide unavailable branches by default in v1.

steps.description: Implement dialogue event contract and dispatch flow: OnDialogueStarted, OnDialogueStepShown, OnDialogueOptionSelected, OnDialogueStepCompleted, OnDialogueCompleted, and OnDialogueBreak.

model_config.system_instruction: Add strongly defined runtime events for dialogue lifecycle, analytics, quest hooks, and presentation sync.

nuances: StepCompleted semantics must differ correctly for Continue, Choice, and End nodes.
Break fires only on cancel or forced close.

steps.description: Create DialogueInteractableZone as IInteractable world entry point with prompt, graphics target, camera pivot, dialogue asset reference, and optional single-use behavior aligned with current interaction patterns.

model_config.system_instruction: Implement a thin world-facing dialogue interactable that plugs into the existing interaction controller without owning runtime session logic.

nuances: Prefer composition over inheriting InteractionTarget.
Graphics target fallback should mirror current project behavior.

steps.description: Implement DialogueOrchestrator to enforce single active session, start from interactable, bind session to presenter, handle cleanup, and coordinate camera, communication state, player freeze, and persistence hooks.

model_config.system_instruction: Implement central dialogue orchestration with deterministic setup and teardown across world, runtime, and UI boundaries.

nuances: UI must not directly toggle character state or camera.
Cleanup must be idempotent on both Completed and Broken paths.
Only one active dialogue allowed globally.

steps.description: Build dialogue UI MVP: view, presenter, and view model for modal window, speaker text, body text, continue action, option list, cancel, and default gamepad focus behavior.

model_config.system_instruction: Implement a clean MVP dialogue UI that remains presentation-only and supports both mouse and gamepad interaction.

nuances: Continue and Choice modes should render through one presenter.
Presenter maps runtime node to view model.
Gamepad navigation must have deterministic initial focus.

steps.description: Implement global dialogue history repository and quest query integration: persist structured choice entries by dialogue/node/choice, expose query API for conditions, and keep break path non-completing.

model_config.system_instruction: Add persistence-facing dialogue history and external quest condition integration with stable ids and low coupling.

nuances: Persist choice on valid option selection, not only on full completion.
History shape must preserve node context for future repeated runs.

steps.description: Integrate character communication sub-state, animation key reservation Talking, input blocking, and camera pivot restore path. Ensure gameplay movement/aim/cast/interact are blocked only for active dialogue lifetime.

model_config.system_instruction: Wire dialogue runtime into character state, animation, and camera behavior with explicit begin/end lifecycle boundaries.

nuances: Communication state should be runtime-driven by orchestrator, not UI-driven.
Animation clip can arrive later, but config key Talking should be wired now.
Restore path must survive break, complete, and exceptional teardown.

steps.description: Add or adjust tests and validation scenarios for node progression, continue steps, branching by previous choice, quest-completed gating, break vs complete lifecycle, history persistence, and cleanup restore invariants.

model_config.system_instruction: Validate critical dialogue invariants and regression-prone integration behavior across runtime, UI, and orchestration layers.

nuances: Cover both mouse and gamepad interaction paths when feasible.
Prioritize lifecycle cleanup and branch correctness.

steps.description: Create or update worklog under Assets/.cursor/docs/worklogs/, document inspector requirements step by step, request final review, and only then finalize one scoped commit with allowed prefix.

model_config.system_instruction: Document implementation traceability, capture inspector setup requirements, and finalize repository state only after approval.

nuances: Every implemented step with repository changes requires reviewer approval before commit.
Exactly one commit for this scoped task.
Include summary, files changed, scene/inspector, validation, decision log, follow-ups, and commit status in worklog.

unresolved_questions: Completed dialogue restart policy: repeatable by config or single-use by default.
Unavailable dialogue options UX: hidden or disabled in final shipped flow.
Need speakerId in v1 runtime contracts now, or speakerName is enough until portraits and richer speaker metadata appear.
